message: Formal Phase 2.3 2000-step training is running as one continuous process. Preload was disabled after an initial memory failure before optimizer steps. Quick compare runs at 500 and 1500; full compare runs at 1000 and 2000; package/offline smoke remain gated by full-set F1 > 0.70.
